$$
100a + 10b + c
$$

### Step 1: Swapping the first and third digits

If we swap the first and third digits, the new number becomes:

$$
c \cdot 100 + b \cdot 10 + a
$$

This increases the original number by 198:

$$
(100a + 10b + c) + 198 = 100c + 10b + a
$$

Subtract the original number:

$$
(100c + 10b + a) - (100a + 10b + c) = 100c - 100a + a - c = 100c - 99a = 198
$$",

$$
100a + 10b + c
$$

---

### Step 1: Swapping the first and third digits

If we swap the first and third digits, the new number becomes:

$$

$$
(100a + 10b + c) + 198 = 100c + 10b + a
$$

Subtract the original number:

$$
(100c + 10b + a) - (100a + 10b + c) = 100c - 100a + a - c = 100c - 99a = 198
